name: Neural Parametric Gaussians
definition: A two-stage method for monocular non-rigid object reconstruction. Stage 1 learns a coarse point model using low-rank deformation bases driven by an MLP. Stage 2 optimizes 3D Gaussians in local volumes defined by the point sets, where Gaussian parameters are shared over time and deformation is driven by the coarse point set.
summary: Neural Parametric Gaussians is a two-stage method for monocular non-rigid object reconstruction that uses a coarse neural point model to drive static 3D Gaussians, avoiding heavy runtime costs.
